guide.outbreak.0.title: The dead
guide.outbreak.0.body:
The dead turn up in small groups, always out of sight, a few dozen blocks away. More come at night.
They don't burn in daylight, and they can break doors down. Most shamble, but a few sprint.
Many still wear their work clothes: cops near police cars, doctors by ambulances, firefighters, builders, mechanics, prisoners, and pilots and soldiers at the airport. What they carried for work is often still on them.
Not all of them walk: crawlers drag themselves through the grass, bloaters burst into a sickening cloud when they fall, and brutes are big, tough and hard to push back.
Now and then a horde roams the streets towards you, and every few days a helicopter passes low overhead and draws every zombie for miles.
guide.outbreak.1.title: Noise
guide.outbreak.1.body:
Sound draws them. Gunshots and running engines send nearby zombies to the spot for about twenty seconds, and they'll attack whatever they find there.
Driving is loud while you're moving, and so are smashing windows and salvaging. A silenced pistol is quieter.
Throw a noise maker to pull them somewhere else.
guide.outbreak.2.title: Bites and infection
guide.outbreak.2.body:
Any bite can infect you. Armour makes it much less likely.
Once infected you have about one Minecraft day (twenty minutes) before you turn. Only antibiotics cure it; milk won't wash it out.
If you turn, a zombie with your name and all your gear rises where you fell.
guide.outbreak.3.title: Actions
guide.outbreak.3.body:
Open the action menu with Left Alt, or Ctrl while standing still. From it you can search, loot all, smash windows, cook, craft, salvage, rip clothes into rags and listen.
Timed actions stop if you move or get hurt.
Shove (B) knocks a zombie back. Reload with R.
guide.outbreak.4.title: Scavenging
guide.outbreak.4.body:
Cupboards, fridges, mailboxes, cars and luggage all hold loot.
With a tool you can salvage cars for scrap, gun parts and batteries, and strip computers and TVs for electronics.
Rags become bandages; scrap, nails and duct tape become better weapons and armour.
Most parked cars still have their keys in them. Locked ones have their key close by: on a zombie, or on the ground. Sneak and use a crowbar or hammer to smash a window instead.
guide.outbreak.5.title: Crafting tiers
guide.outbreak.5.body:
Start makeshift: bandages, nail boards, spears and bats.
Then reinforced bats, scrap armour and spiked weapons.
At the top: Kevlar vests, tactical helmets, night vision goggles, pipe bombs, molotovs, and guns built from gun parts.
guide.outbreak.6.title: Clearing an area
guide.outbreak.6.body:
The world is split into 128-block areas, each with a limited number of dead. Every kill thins that area out, and a cleared area stays quiet.
Stragglers wander back slowly, about one every thirty seconds.
Use Listen to hear how busy an area still is.
guide.outbreak.7.title: The airport
guide.outbreak.7.body:
The airport fell early and is packed with the dead: a fixed horde, and nothing new ever spawns there. Kill them all and it's yours for good.
Listen tells you how many are left. The hangars are worth the trip.
guide.outbreak.8.title: Power
guide.outbreak.8.body:
The city grid is down. Lights, TVs, vending machines, ATMs and stoves need your own power.
Generators run on fuel; solar panels work by day; wind turbines never stop. Batteries store the surplus, and power poles carry it, each within 16 blocks of the next.
A redstone signal works in a pinch.
Nights are truly dark now. Flashlights (houses, garages, police) light whatever you point them at; recharge them with a car battery.

guide.outbreak.9.title: Barricades
guide.outbreak.9.body:
Board up doors, windows and gaps in walls: look at one, open the action menu and pick Board up. You need a claw hammer, a plank and 2 nails each time, and up to 4 planks fit. Sneaking and using a claw hammer on a door or window does the same.
Sheet metal (4 scrap metal, or salvaged from cars) takes 4 nails and is far tougher than wood.
Zombies chasing you, or a noise behind a barricade, will beat on it until it gives. Each plank breaks in turn, so listen for the banging and nail on more.
Hammering is loud. Barricade before dark, and pry planks off with a hammer or crowbar to get them back.
Every world starts with character creation: where you wake up, your occupation and traits, your name and look. Your occupation decides your starting kit and what you're good at; good traits cost points, bad ones earn them.

spawn.outbreak.suburbs.desc: Quiet streets of family homes on the edge of the city. Kitchens, garages and cars in the driveways: a good place to scavenge and fortify. Fewer of the dead than downtown, but they are still here.
spawn.outbreak.downtown.desc: The heart of the city: towers, shops, offices and crowds. The best loot and the most zombies. For survivors who like to live dangerously, briefly.
spawn.outbreak.countryside.desc: Farms, forests and dirt roads between the cities. Few zombies, little to scavenge, a long way from help. Good for a quiet start, if you can feed yourself.
spawn.outbreak.spawn.desc: The world's own spawn point. In a Vehicle Forge city that's the central park, right in the middle of everything.
spawn.outbreak.random.desc: Let fate decide: the suburbs, downtown or the countryside.
occupation.outbreak.unemployed.desc: No skills, no gear, but plenty of points to spend on traits.
occupation.outbreak.police_officer.desc: Starts with a loaded pistol, spare 9mm, a police vest and a baton.
occupation.outbreak.firefighter.desc: Fit and tough: +1 heart of health. Starts with a fire axe and turnout gear.
Barricades and pries boards off twice as fast. Starts with a claw hammer, nails, planks and a hard hat.
occupation.outbreak.doctor.desc: Heals over time and uses medicine faster. Starts with a first aid kit, bandages, antibiotics and painkillers.
occupation.outbreak.mechanic.desc: Salvages cars and machines twice as fast. Starts with a pipe wrench, a car battery, scrap and duct tape.
occupation.outbreak.burglar.desc: Searches cars and loots containers quicker. Starts with a crowbar, a flashlight and a backpack.
occupation.outbreak.chef.desc: Starts with a kitchen knife, a frying pan and a few cans of food.
occupation.outbreak.park_ranger.desc: At home in the wild. Starts with a machete, a flashlight, a backpack and an MRE.
occupation.outbreak.lumberjack.desc: Hits a little harder. Starts with a fire axe, logs and work boots.
occupation.outbreak.fitness_instructor.d: 10% faster on foot. Starts with sneakers, energy bars and energy drinks.
occupation.outbreak.veteran.desc: Has seen worse: panics far less. Starts with a loaded pistol, ammo, a military vest and a helmet.

guide.outbreak.10.title: Skills and safehouses
guide.outbreak.10.body:
Skills go up as you use them, from 0 to 10. Aiming (shooting zombies): tighter, harder-hitting shots. Melee (killing zombies hand to hand): harder hits. Fitness (sprinting): faster on foot. Carpentry, Mechanics, First Aid and Scavenging (barricading, salvaging, using medicine, searching): those jobs go quicker. Your occupation gives you a head start. See them all on your character sheet in the action menu.
Find a building you like, barricade it, and claim it as your safehouse from the action menu. No zombies spawn inside it, you heal while you rest there if you're fed, it's marked green on your minimap, and you wake up there. Put a rain barrel outside for water.

guide.outbreak.11.title: Books, animals, traps and the map
guide.outbreak.11.body:
Skill books come in three volumes per skill. Hold right-click to read one in good light: if it's pitched at your level you learn a level's worth. Each book teaches you once.
The infection reached the animals: feral dogs hunt in packs outdoors, mostly at night, and infected rats swarm in dark buildings. Both can infect you with a bite.
Protect your safehouse with traps: bear traps snap shut on whatever steps in them (sneak to step over), spike strips hurt anything walking across, barbed wire tangles and cuts, and a tin can alarm tells you when something walks through it.
Your world map (J, or the action menu) fills in as you explore and is saved for each world.
